acceptDeal(uint256).notice: Step 3: counterparty accepts by posting their own collateral.

claimExpired(uint256).notice: Anyone can trigger cleanup once the deadline has passed         without completion. Refunds go back to whoever funded them.

confirmCompletion(uint256).notice: Creator confirms the work is done. Pays out immediately.

createDeal(address,uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Step 1: creator proposes a deal. No funds move yet.

fundDeal(uint256).notice: Step 2: creator deposits amount + their own collateral.

openDispute(uint256).notice: Either party can escalate to the trusted reviewer while ACTIVE.

requestCompletion(uint256).notice: Counterparty signals the work is done. Does not move funds.

resolveDispute(uint256,address).notice: Reviewer answers one question only: who gets the full pot?         The reviewer never touches funds directly — this function does.
